title: Kalmar Delivers Five Container Handling Machines To Damietta Terminal
paragraphs: Dubai ( PlantAndEquipment.com ) - Kalmar has delivered five new cargo-handling equipment to Damietta Container & Cargo Handling Company (DCHC) in Egypt, in collaboration with its local distributor Kabadaya Specialized Equipment.
The delivery included four 45-tonne Kalmar reachstackers and one 33-tonne Kalmar Super Heavy Forklift , which are already operational at DCHC.
The agreement also includes replacement parts and operator training, with Kabadaya providing local support for the equipment in Egypt.
The new machines will help DCHC's container and cargo handling activities at Damietta, providing additional heavy-lifting capability for terminal operations.

title: MAN Truck & Bus Appoints Libya Motors Company As Official Dealer In Libya
paragraphs: Dubai ( PlantAndEquipment.com ) - MAN Truck & Bus has selected Libya Motors Company (LMC) as its official distributor in Libya, signaling a fresh push by the commercial vehicle maker into the North African market.
The cooperation was officially formed at IAA Transportation 2026 in Hannover, with LMC handling MAN vehicle sales, as well as service and aftersales support for clients across Libya.

MAN stated that LMC was chosen for its strong local presence and automotive sector knowledge. The cooperation will concentrate on growing the MAN business in Libya while also providing lifecycle support to truck and transport companies.
The appointment provides MAN with a committed local partner as demand for commercial vehicles and transportation equipment rises with Libya's infrastructure, logistics, and restoration activities.

title: Dubai RTA Awards $316m Contracts For Al Meydan Street Development
paragraphs: Dubai ( PlantAndEquipment.com ) - Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has granted two contracts totaling AED 1.161 billion ($316 million) for the Al Meydan Street Development Project, which is slated to be completed by the end of 2028.

The RTA will build 3.7km of bridges and 17km of roadways, as well as bicycle facilities, to transform Al Meydan Street into a stronger parallel corridor that supports Sheik Mohammed bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road.

The first contract comprises around 14 kilometers and includes modifications to Al Meydan Street and Al Marabea' Street. The works comprise a grade-separated junction between Al Marabea' Street and Al Meydan Street with 1.6km of bridges, four lanes in each direction, and a capacity of 14,400 cars per hour.
It also comprises a three-lane connection between Al Marabea' Street and Sheik Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, as well as a 700-metre elevated link from Dubai-Al Ain Road to Nad Al Hamar Street.

The second contract extends Al Meydan Street between First Al Khail Street and Muscat Street and includes about 2 kilometers of additional surface roadways leading to Latifa bint Hamdan Street. The Al Meydan Street-Muscat Street intersection will be upgraded to a multi-level interchange with 1.4 km of bridges and four lanes in each direction.

Once finished, the expansion is planned to enhance north-south traffic capacity by 18% and reduce travel time between Al Manama Street/Dubai-Al Ain Road and Umm Suqeim Street from 30 minutes to 10 minutes.
The system will service about 500,000 people, including Dubai Hills, Nad Al Sheba, Mohammed Bin Rashid Gardens, District One, and Al Barari.

title: HELI Showcases Core Product Lines At Saudi Warehousing & Logistics Expo 2026, Strengthening Its Presence In The Middle East Logistics Market
paragraphs: Core Products on Display to Meet Diverse Operational Needs

The Saudi Warehousing & Logistics Expo 2026 recently opened successfully at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC). As one of the world's leading industrial vehicle brands, HELI showcased a range of material handling equipment at Booth 2C140, presenting a product portfolio tailored to local operating conditions in the Middle East, alongside an integrated service system. HELI provides customers across the region with comprehensive material handling solutions for a wide range of applications.
Efficient & Sustainable – Supporting Warehouse Electrification Upgrades

The G2 Series lithium-ion battery forklifts are HELI’s flagship products developed in response to the growing trend toward green warehousing. With fast charging capabilities and long operating endurance, the series is designed to support extended, continuous indoor operations. The forklifts come standard with safety features including turning speed control, mast cushioning, and active safety systems. Combined with a wide-visibility mast design, they deliver an effective balance between operational efficiency and operator safety, well aligned with the accelerating shift toward electrification in warehousing and logistics across the Middle East.
Heavy-Duty Performance for Challenging Working Conditions

Heavy-duty operations were another major highlight at HELI's booth. Tailored for applications such as building material yards, port logistics, and heavy manufacturing, HELI presented its G3 Series Internal Combustion Forklifts covering the 5-to-10-ton capacity range. Powered by Mitsubishi, Cummins, or Isuzu powertrains, the series delivers strong output with a maximum gradeability of 40% under full load, making it well suited to heavy-load material handling and ramp operations.
One Machine, Multiple Functions for Versatile Mid- and High-Level Operations

The 40THCJ telescopic handler on display features a rated load capacity of 3.5–5 tons, a maximum lifting height of 18,200 mm, and a maximum forward reach of 14,230 mm. Equipped with a Cummins engine with a rated power output of 97 kW, the machine also offers a minimum ground clearance exceeding 400 mm. Integrating lifting, stacking, and short-distance material handling capabilities, the machine is well suited for uneven terrain and meets diverse loading and unloading requirements at elevated working heights and extended reach.
Efficient Turnaround for Enhancing Port Logistics Chains

Engineered for container transfer at ports and inland terminals, HELI reach stackers offer high-capacity lifting and efficient container stacking. Built with a robust and reliable structure designed to withstand the demanding requirements of outdoor and high-frequency operations at ports across the Middle East, they can significantly improve container handling and turnaround efficiency, helping enhance the overall efficiency of regional port logistics operations.
Superior Off-Road Capability for Challenging Outdoor Applications

HELI Rough Terrain Forklifts come equipped with specialized off-road tires, a high-ground-clearance chassis, and a four-wheel-drive system for enhanced traction and mobility. They can confidently operate on challenging surfaces such as sand, mud, and unpaved terrain, while maintaining stable performance under heavy loads. They expand material handling boundaries across construction sites, mining areas, and outdoor yards where conventional forklifts may not be suitable.
Strengthening Localized Capabilities from Products to Services

Localized service capabilities are also a key factor for Chinese industrial vehicle brands expanding into the Middle East. HELI has established a comprehensive dealer network and spare parts supply system across the Middle East, upgrading its offering from individual product sales to integrated "Product + Service" solutions. At this expo, HELI also highlighted localized maintenance, rapid-response after-sales support, and full-cycle service capabilities. Through local service outlets and professional technical teams, HELI provides customers with timely equipment maintenance, spare parts supply, and technical support, effectively reducing total lifecycle operating costs and reinforcing long-term trust and cooperation with local partners.
